raw_evidence.context: External Engagement | Staff - UCL – University College London Close Study Research Engage About Give Staff Home Home UCL Home Staff External engagement UCL Home Staff External engagement External Engagement Find out all you need to know about communications (internal and external), marketing, student recruitment, digital, media relations, public affairs, and institutional events at UCL. Work with the Vice-President External Engagement (VPEE) teams to achieve UCL's mission to communicate and engage effectively with the world. The Vice-President for External Engagement role and portfolio were created at the end of 2021 as part of the senior leadership team's revision of portfolios and teams in preparation for the delivery of our new five-year strategy. Building on existing strengths, our VPEE teams ensure that UCL’s public prominence, reputation and influence reflects our excellence in knowledge creation, education, and innovation while promoting the public value of university research and partnerships to the future of Global Britain. Changes include the creation of a new Public Affairs team, and an expanded Events team to include dedicated support for high-level institutional events. We are committed to bringing people together to create an engagement and influence powerhouse for UCL with expertise of communications, media relations, public affairs, marketing, digital and events. We look forward to working with our partners within UCL and externally to ensure UCL’s public profile reflects our excellence in knowledge creation, education, and innovation. Kirsty Walker Vice-President External Engagement Browse below or click here access the VPEE Sharepoint (login required) Find out more Access our resources Click on the box links below or contact us with your query .
